verdict.rationale: Autumn provides `atmn pull` to export pricing/plan config into a local `autumn.config.ts` file and an `atmn api` command to call any endpoint from the terminal, giving some open-format access to configuration data, but there is no documented bulk export of customer, usage, or billing history data for leaving the platform. missing for 10: full customer/usage/billing data export documentation, explicit open-format (CSV/JSON) export tooling, and any migration-out guide.
